title: The Lantern of Manchester's mill district
author: Noor Lockridge
blurb: Rafael Nystrom, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
